uncited: This family defines reference training protocols for differentiable volume rendering, establishing hyperparameters, optimization strategies, and architectural configurations for radiance field models, detailed in [NeRF-GT Baseline Training Setup](11349-nerf-gt-baseline-training-setup.md), [StyleGAN2 Training Configuration](12972-stylegan2-training-configuration.md), [NeRF Training Setup](13271-nerf-training-setup.md), and [NLR Baseline](15254-nlr-baseline.md).

All children build on the core differentiable volume rendering pipeline defined in [NeRF Training Loop](1522-training-loop-setup.md) [11349-nerf-gt-baseline-training-setup.md][13271-nerf-training-setup.md][15254-nlr-baseline.md].
Configures training for sparse volume representations using hierarchical neural networks.
It addresses the trade-off between noise reduction and computational efficiency in VDB-based rendering.
Choose this when high-resolution sparse volume reconstruction is required.

*   **Step:** Batch sampling strategy is either drawing $2^{16}$ random samples per epoch, or resampling a subset of input voxels at fixed intervals (100 or 500) and drawing $2^{12}$ batches per epoch.
The resampled subset size equals the resampling intervals multiplied by the batch size.
Network width: Level-1 networks use half the width of level-0 networks.
Default starting point: level-0 width 128, depth 3.
Block grid (dense leaf nodes without active masks) reduces noise but still shows visible fog artifacts.
Configures training for compact real-time radiance fields using a Neural Codebook (NCB).
It focuses on efficient storage and fast inference through codebook quantization.
Choose this for real-time applications requiring compact representation.
